{{Top|leg}}
'''Merry Havoc''' was the name that noted [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Palleus Chuff]] used to characterize one of the facial expressions used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Chuff's portrayal of Yoda in ''[[Jedi!]]'', granted him [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] fame.
